description: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device

latest_release.name: v1.6.5
latest_release.body:
# Added

- Madeira is now fetched from its main repo, with stable and nightly releases being given as a choice to the user

# Fixed

- An imported SideStore, LiveContainer + SideStore or Madeira .ipa is now set up just like the download, including SideStore's pairing file and certificate (#108). Where GitHub can't be reached, as in mainland China, a card explains how to bring the .ipa this way.
- Apps with an ExtensionKit extension (in Extensions rather than PlugIns) install instead of failing with “Mismatched bundle IDs”: those extensions now get the app's new bundle ID, its provisioning profile and their own signature (#110).
- Apps with data after a binary's signature, such as IPAs taken from a TrollStore install, can be signed instead of stopping with “cannot grow a code signature that is not at the end of the Mach-O slice” (#109).
- Side by Side's progress bar now moves during “Install on their iPhone” too.

# Changed

- A certificate can be exported without a password (#99). Feather and other signing apps import such a .p12; a Mac's Keychain needs one with a password.

# SideInstaller **Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.** [![Install](https://img.shields.io/badge/Install-SideInstaller-2ea44f?style=for-the-badge)](https://sideinstaller.net/) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.6.5-blue?style=for-the-badge)](CHANGELOG.md) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-iOS-lightgrey?style=for-the-badge&logo=apple)](#requirements) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Custom-orange?style=for-the-badge)](LICENSE.md)
--- > [!CAUTION] > **Only install SideInstaller from the official source.** > > This project is open source, which means anyone can fork the code, insert a credential stealer that > uploads your Apple ID and password to their own server, rebuild it, and redistribute it under the same > name and icon. A malicious fork looks identical to the real app from the outside. > > The **only** builds I publish are: > - **Website:** https://sideinstaller.net/ > - **Repository:** https://github.com/FrizzleM/SideInstaller > > Do not install SideInstaller from any other site, AltStore source, Telegram channel, Discord server, > app repo, or mirror, no matter how official it looks. Redistributing my builds without explicit consent is also prohibited by > the [license](LICENSE.md). > > There is a fake site called “sideinstaller.com”. This site is **not legit**, and is likely providing malware. Please make sure > you only download from the **official sources** listed above. --- ## What it is SideStore and LiveContainer are currently the best way to sideload on iOS. However, there's one big problem: installing them requires a PC, which many people don't have. That's why I made SideInstaller, a free and open-source iOS app that installs them directly on your iPhone, no PC required. SideInstaller handles the entire setup process on-device. It takes care of the pairing, provisioning, and installation steps that normally force you to plug into a computer and run desktop tools, all from a single app running on the phone itself. Once it's done, you get a fully working SideStore and LiveContainer setup ready to sideload your own apps. The whole thing is built to be simple. There's no complicated configuration, no command line, and no need to understand how any of the underlying machinery works. You just open the app, follow a few steps, and let it do the rest. For anyone who's ever wanted to sideload but didn't own a Mac or PC, this removes the biggest barrier to getting started. And because it's open source, you don't have to take my word for any of it. The full code is available for anyone to read, audit, or contribute to, so you can see exactly what's running on your device. ## Requirements - An iPhone or iPad on iOS 27+ (iOS 17.4+ with a pairing file made on a computer; from iOS 26.4, a [remote pairing one](#ios-264-to-26x-a-remote-pairing-file)) - Wi-F
